messages:
alex: Heads-up, paging from alert-bridge started dropping for eu-prod around 08:42 UTC. seeing lots of 400s decompress error in logs
ops-bot: [alert] alert-bridge: decompression_failed rate 34/min
priya: any customer pages? incidentbot didn't send for some alerts
alex: looks like incidentbot started suppressing due to unexpected header version; also saw `decompress failed: msgpack: unexpected EOF` in proxy
jorge: attaching snippet from logs: ```
2026-03-18T08:42:31Z alert-bridge error decompress: msgpack: unexpected EOF
2026-03-18T08:42:31Z incidentbot warn incoming-webhook header: "X-Alert-Version": "v2"
```
carol-svcs: ok i'm rolling bridge to disable decompression until we patch; command: `kubectl set env deploy/alert-bridge ALERT_DECOMPRESS=false`
oncall-jordan: i'm oncall, switching to manual pages. priya pls start manual ringdowns for affected alerts
priya: manual pages started, pinging CS for outreach
alex: mitigation: redeploy done, fallback to legacy compressor confirmed
ops-bot: deploy alert-bridge v39 started
priya: incidentbot still mis-parsing some webhooks, patch for header parsing inbound from jorge
jorge: pushed parsing patch, testing in staging, will hotfix on prod once validated
oncall-jordan: how many customers impacted?
alex: estimate ~12 tenants, 6 had missed pages for ~6 minutes, none escalated to P0 but CS has two support tickets
priya: CS and support notified, outreach in progress
carol-svcs: bridge now on legacy flow, decompress errors gone, healthchecks green
ops-bot: deploy v39 completed (2m35s)
oncall-jordan: manual pages caught up, verifying no lingering silences
priya: follow-up: create postmortem, add healthcheck for decompress errors, add incidentbot header-version tolerance
alex: action items: canary header change next time, auto-fallback to legacy compression, unit tests for incidentbot header parsing
oncall-jordan: i'll hold handoff for 1hr then pass to night team
priya: thanks all :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incident ticket INC-2026-462 created and linked
